edges.reason: _uri parameter is stored into baseURI during initialize.
_maxMint parameter initializes the maxMint state variable.
_maxPerWallet parameter initializes the maxPerWallet state variable.
_state parameter is written into isMintEnabled.
_uri parameter overwrites the baseURI state variable.
_isBurnEnabled parameter is written into isBurnEnabled.
_count bounds the loop that increments the token id counter.
_count is both checked against and added to userMintCount.
Length of _adds bounds the counter increments during airdrop.
_adds provides the recipient list iterated by airdropTokens.
tokenId parameter is the subject of the burn authorization check and burn.
_account indexes userMintCount in getMintsLeft.
_account parameter is used in the getMintsLeft view computation.
newImplementation is passed into the _authorizeUpgrade access control gate.
newImplementation flows into upgradeTo before authorization.
newImplementation flows into upgradeToAndCall before authorization.
newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
newOwner is written into the _owner storage slot granting privileges.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner slot.
msg.sender is the mint recipient and the key used for userMintCount.
msg.sender indexes the userMintCount mapping.
msg.sender must pass _isApprovedOrOwner before burning.
msg.sender is compared with owner() in the onlyOwner modifier of setMintState.
msg.sender is compared with owner() in the onlyOwner modifier of setBaseURI.
msg.sender is compared with owner() in the onlyOwner modifier of setBurnState.
msg.sender must be the owner to call the airdropTokens batch mint.
msg.sender must be the owner for the upgrade authorization hook.
Loop index advances the token id counter on each iteration.
Loop index controls repeated mint iterations inside userMint.
Loop index advances the token id counter during the airdrop loop.
Loop index controls iteration over the airdrop recipient array.
tokenIdCounter.current() is read for the total supply limit and token ids.
tokenIdCounter.current() is read to validate the airdrop size.
totalSupply reads the token id counter state.
userMintCount is read to enforce the per-wallet cap.
getMintsLeft reads userMintCount for the queried account.
maxPerWallet is subtracted by the account mint count in getMintsLeft.
maxPerWallet is read when validating the requested mint count.
maxMint is read when validating total supply after the mint.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
isMintEnabled is required to be true before userMint proceeds.
isBurnEnabled is required to be true before burn proceeds.
The _status reentrancy lock gates entry into userMint.
onlyOwner checks the _owner slot before setMintState executes.
onlyOwner checks the _owner slot before setBaseURI executes.
onlyOwner checks the _owner slot before setBurnState executes.
onlyOwner checks the _owner slot before airdropTokens executes.
onlyOwner checks the _owner slot before _authorizeUpgrade executes.
onlyOwner checks the _owner slot before transferOwnership executes.
initialize assigns the base URI storage variable.
initialize assigns the maxMint storage variable.
initialize assigns the maxPerWallet storage variable.
initialize calls __Ownable_init which sets the owner slot.
initialize calls __ReentrancyGuard_init which sets _status.
userMint calls _safeMint for each minted token, transferring control to the token recipient.
airdropTokens calls _safeMint for each recipient address.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received on contract recipients.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received call modelled by the unsafe operation.
userMint reaches the external ERC721 receiver callback through _safeMint.
airdropTokens reaches the external ERC721 receiver callback through _safeMint.
Attacker controlled receiver can re-enter userMint before userMintCount is updated; the nonReentrant guard reverts such re-entry.
userMintCount is written only after the external call loop, so a reentrant entry could observe stale counts.
tokenIdCounter is incremented before each external safe mint call.
userMint triggers the unchecked counter increment each iteration.
airdropTokens triggers the unchecked counter increment each iteration.
The unchecked increment writes tokenIdCounter._value without overflow protection.
upgradeTo calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade.
upgradeToAndCall calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade.
upgradeTo can reach the delegatecall path during implementation upgrade.
upgradeToAndCall reaches the delegatecall path executing supplied data.
A delegatecall upgrade executes in proxy storage and can overwrite the _owner slot.
A delegatecall upgrade can overwrite the treasury storage slot.
burn delegates to the internal _burn implementation after authorization.

normalization_plan.reason: initialize._uri is a transient parameter whose only role is assigning baseURI inside initialize.
initialize._maxMint is a transient parameter consumed by the maxMint assignment in initialize.
initialize._maxPerWallet is a transient parameter consumed by the maxPerWallet assignment in initialize.
setMintState._state is the sole input written to isMintEnabled by setMintState.
setBaseURI._uri is the sole input written to baseURI by setBaseURI.
setBurnState._isBurnEnabled is the sole input written to isBurnEnabled by setBurnState.
userMint._count only exists to bound the mint loop and the userMintCount update in userMint.
airdropTokens._adds is the recipient array consumed exclusively by airdropTokens.
burn.tokenId is the authorization subject and burn target of burn.
getMintsLeft._account is only used to index userMintCount in getMintsLeft.
_authorizeUpgrade.newImplementation is the argument of the upgrade gate _authorizeUpgrade before it reaches upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall.
transferOwnership.newOwner is validated and written to the owner slot by transferOwnership.
userMint.i is a loop index with no meaning outside the mint loop of userMint.
airdropTokens.i is a loop index with no meaning outside the airdrop loop of airdropTokens.
